summary: Design teams in organizations scaling digital product development can use Penpot to manage design systems and collaborate with developers. This open-source platform enables teams to work with open standards, maintain ownership of their design infrastructure, and ensure compliance with governance requirements. By connecting design, code, and AI workflows, Penpot helps teams ship designed products and manage complex design systems at scale. The platform supports real-time collaboration, flexible deployment options, and integrations with development toolchains. Penpot's features, such as design tokens and components, facilitate consistency and reusability in UI design across projects and platforms.
